statement:
theorem abs_tailStep_sub_tailStep (a : PartialQuotient) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    |1 / ((a.1 : ℝ) + x) - 1 / ((a.1 : ℝ) + y)| =
      |x - y| / (((a.1 : ℝ) + x) * ((a.1 : ℝ) + y))

name: HallRay.ContinuedFraction.abs_two_tailSteps_sub_le

theorem abs_two_tailSteps_sub_le (a b : PartialQuotient) {x y : ℝ}
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hy : y ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    |1 / ((a.1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((b.1 : ℝ) + x)) -
        1 / ((a.1 : ℝ) + 1 / ((b.1 : ℝ) + y))| ≤
      |x - y| / 4

name: HallRay.Cantor.hall_length_condition
statement:
theorem hall_length_condition (w : Word) (k : ℕ) (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk3 : k ≤ 3) :
    let x0 := (k : ℝ) + delta
    let x1 := (k : ℝ) + epsilon
    let x2 := (k : ℝ) + 1 + delta
    let x3 := 4 + epsilon
    |prefixMap w x1 - prefixMap w x0| ≥
        |prefixMap w x2 - prefixMap w x1| ∧
      |prefixMap w x3 - prefixMap w x2| ≥
        |prefixMap w x2 - prefixMap w x1|

name: HallRay.Cantor.prefixMap_four_order
statement:
theorem prefixMap_four_order (w : Word) (k : ℕ)
    (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk3 : k ≤ 3) :
    let x0 := (k : ℝ) + delta
    let x1 := (k : ℝ) + epsilon
    let x2 := (k : ℝ) + 1 + delta
    let x3 := 4 + epsilon
    (prefixMap w x0 ≤ prefixMap w x1 ∧
      prefixMap w x1 ≤ prefixMap w x2 ∧
      prefixMap w x2 ≤ prefixMap w x3) ∨
    (prefixMap w x3 ≤ prefixMap w x2 ∧
      prefixMap w x2 ≤ prefixMap w x1 ∧
      prefixMap w x1 ≤ prefixMap w x0)

name: HallRay.Cantor.prefixMap_interval_split
statement:
theorem prefixMap_interval_split (w : Word) (k : ℕ)
    (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk3 : k ≤ 3) :
    let x0 := (k : ℝ) + delta
    let x1 := (k : ℝ) + epsilon
    let x2 := (k : ℝ) + 1 + delta
    let x3 := 4 + epsilon
    Set.uIcc (prefixMap w x0) (prefixMap w x3) \
        Set.uIoo (prefixMap w x1) (prefixMap w x2) =
      Set.uIcc (prefixMap w x0) (prefixMap w x1) ∪
        Set.uIcc (prefixMap w x2) (prefixMap w x3)

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_Icc_split

theorem minkowskiSum_Icc_split {a b c d u v : ℝ}

    (hgap : d - c ≤ v - u) :
    minkowskiSum (Set.Icc a b) (Set.Icc u v) =
      minkowskiSum (Set.Icc a c ∪ Set.Icc d b) (Set.Icc u v)

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_Icc_split_self

    minkowskiSum (Set.Icc a b) (Set.Icc a b) =
      minkowskiSum (Set.Icc a c ∪ Set.Icc d b)
        (Set.Icc a c ∪ Set.Icc d b)

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_mono
HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_uIcc_split
statement:
theorem minkowskiSum_uIcc_split {x0 x1 x2 x3 u v : ℝ}
    (horder :
      (x0 ≤ x1 ∧ x1 ≤ x2 ∧ x2 ≤ x3) ∨
      (x3 ≤ x2 ∧ x2 ≤ x1 ∧ x1 ≤ x0))
    (hgap : |x2 - x1| ≤ |v - u|) :
    minkowskiSum (Set.uIcc x0 x3) (Set.uIcc u v) =
      minkowskiSum (Set.uIcc x0 x1 ∪ Set.uIcc x2 x3) (Set.uIcc u v)

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_uIcc_split_self
statement:
theorem minkowskiSum_uIcc_split_self {x0 x1 x2 x3 : ℝ}
    (horder :
      (x0 ≤ x1 ∧ x1 ≤ x2 ∧ x2 ≤ x3) ∨
      (x3 ≤ x2 ∧ x2 ≤ x1 ∧ x1 ≤ x0))
    (hleft : |x2 - x1| ≤ |x1 - x0|)
    (hright : |x2 - x1| ≤ |x3 - x2|) :
    minkowskiSum (Set.uIcc x0 x3) (Set.uIcc x0 x3) =
      minkowskiSum (Set.uIcc x0 x1 ∪ Set.uIcc x2 x3)
        (Set.uIcc x0 x1 ∪ Set.uIcc x2 x3)

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_union_left
statement:
theorem minkowskiSum_union_left (X₁ X₂ Y : Set ℝ) :
    minkowskiSum (X₁ ∪ X₂) Y =
      minkowskiSum X₁ Y ∪ minkowskiSum X₂ Y

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_union_right
statement:
theorem minkowskiSum_union_right (X Y₁ Y₂ : Set ℝ) :
    minkowskiSum X (Y₁ ∪ Y₂) =
      minkowskiSum X Y₁ ∪ minkowskiSum X Y₂

name: HallRay.Interval.minkowskiSum_union_split_self
statement:
theorem minkowskiSum_union_split_self {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (l r : ι → ℝ) {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hvalid : ∀ i ∈ s, l i ≤ r i)
    (hrest : ∀ i ∈ s, d - c ≤ r i - l i)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) (hdb : d ≤ b)
    (hleft : d - c ≤ c - a) (hright : d - c ≤ b - d) :
    let R := intervalUnion s l r
    let A := Set.Icc a b
    let S := Set.Icc a c ∪ Set.Icc d b
    minkowskiSum (A ∪ R) (A ∪ R) =
      minkowskiSum (S ∪ R) (S ∪ R)

name: HallRay.Cantor.HallNode.child_gap_le

name: HallRay.Cantor.HallNode.gapLength_eq_coords
statement:
theorem HallNode.gapLength_eq_coords (v : HallNode) :

theorem HallNode.gapLength_eq_gapAt (v : HallNode) :

theorem HallNode.minkowskiSum_interval_with (v u : HallNode)

name: HallRay.Cantor.HallNode.minkowskiSum_union_split
statement:
theorem HallNode.minkowskiSum_union_split (v : HallNode) (rest : List HallNode)
    (hrest : ∀ u ∈ rest, v.gapLength ≤ u.intervalLength) :
    let A := v.interval
    let S := v.leftChild.interval ∪ v.rightChild.interval
    let R := nodeUnion rest
    minkowskiSum (A ∪ R) (A ∪ R) =
      minkowskiSum (S ∪ R) (S ∪ R)

name: HallRay.Cantor.gapAt_append_one_eq
statement:
theorem gapAt_append_one_eq (w : Word) (q : PartialQuotient) :
    gapAt (w ++ [q]) 1 =
      |prefixMap w ((q.1 : ℝ) + alpha) -
        prefixMap w ((q.1 : ℝ) + beta)|

name: HallRay.Cantor.gapAt_append_one_le

theorem gapAt_append_one_le (w : Word) (q : PartialQuotient) (k : ℕ)

    (hrel : q.1 = k ∨ (q.1 = 4 ∧ k = 3)) :
    gapAt (w ++ [q]) 1 ≤ gapAt w k

theorem eventually_lambda_sparseSequence_lt_add
    (a : PartialQuotient) (b c : ℕ → PartialQuotient)
    (hb : ∀ n, (b n).1 ≤ 4) (hc : ∀ n, (c n).1 ≤ 4)
    (hell : 6 ≤ (a.1 : ℝ) + value 0 c + value 0 b)
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ p : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
      lambda (sparseSequence a b c) p <
        (a.1 : ℝ) + value 0 c + value 0 b + ε

    (hbdd : Filter.IsBoundedUnder LE.le Filter.atTop
      (fun n : ℕ ↦ lambda A n))
    (hj : Filter.Tendsto j Filter.atTop Filter.atTop)
    (hsub : Filter.Tendsto (fun n ↦ lambda A (j n)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 ell))
    (hupper : ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, lambda A n < ell + ε) :
    lagrangeValue A = ell
